vb_textbox.text: You can differentiate the gnomes from the size of their hat. Pick one size first, then if it gives 5 or more, keep picking it until it gives 3 or less. Then choose the other size and see if it gives more. If it does, keep picking it until it also gives you 3 or less. 9 is the max amount I get per harvest while 0 is the least. Just be consistent in picking the size if it gives more than 5.
